title: 激光对眼睛和皮肤的伤害
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/113_激光对眼睛和皮肤的伤害.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/113_激光对眼睛和皮肤的伤害/src.py

points.K2: 晶状体聚焦：进眼的光强许多倍
points.K3: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
points.K4: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
points.K6: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
points.K9: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一个大眼球模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hugs a large model of a human eyeball and smiles at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光怎样伤眼睛和皮肤。
overlay: 激光对眼睛和皮肤的伤害

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰在光学平台旁弯腰，眼睛降到光束高度
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends down beside an optical table so that his eyes are level with the beam path.
shots.narration: 阿杰弯腰调光路，眼睛到了光束高度。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他手腕上的手表闪过一道反光
shots.prompt_en: A flash of light glints off the metal watch on his wrist near the beam.
shots.narration: 手表一晃，反出一道光。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研赶紧叫停，让他站直并关掉光闸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls out, asks him to stand up straight and closes the beam shutter.
shots.narration: 小研叫停：反射光一样能伤眼。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 眼睛和照相机并排比较
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway eye beside a camera, their matching parts linked by arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 眼睛是一台接收、聚焦、感光的仪器。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 光依次穿过角膜、晶状体，落到视网膜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light ray passing through the cornea and the lens and landing on the retina. No text.
shots.narration: 光穿过角膜、晶状体，落到视网膜。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 角膜像一扇透明窗，表面细胞在更新
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cornea drawn as a clear front window, its surface cells renewing. No text.
shots.narration: 角膜是透明窗口，轻伤好得较快。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 角膜后面的房水，吸收热量的小波纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the clear fluid behind the cornea soaking up small heat waves. No text.
shots.narration: 房水主要是水，能吸收热量。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 晶状体变厚变薄，看近看远
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the eye lens changing shape, thicker for near objects and thinner for far ones. No text.
shots.narration: 晶状体会变形，远近都能看清。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 亮处瞳孔变小，暗处瞳孔变大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pupil small in bright light and wide open in a dark room. No text.
shots.narration: 暗室里瞳孔大，进眼的光更多。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 视网膜像屏幕，中央凹画成一个亮点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the retina drawn as a screen at the back of the eye, a small central pit highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 中央凹管最精细的视力。

shots.section_title: 眼睛是一台光学仪器
shots.scene: 中央凹被烧出一个黑点，视野中心一片黑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dark burn mark on the central pit and a field of view with a dark spot in the middle. No text.
shots.narration: 激光伤到中央凹，视力损失最重。

shots.section_title: 晶状体聚焦：进眼的光强许多倍
shots.scene: 晶状体像放大镜，把光聚成一点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the eye lens drawn like a magnifying glass, focusing light into one tiny point. No text.
shots.narration: 晶状体像放大镜，把光聚成一点。
overlay: 晶状体聚焦：进眼的光强许多倍

shots.section_title: 晶状体聚焦：进眼的光强许多倍
shots.scene: 眼前的大光斑到眼底变成极小亮点，能量柱猛涨
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wide spot in front of the eye becomes a tiny bright point on the retina, with a soaring energy bar. No text.
shots.narration: 同样的光，到眼底强了许多许多倍。

shots.section_title: 晶状体聚焦：进眼的光强许多倍
shots.scene: 一束杂散激光射进眼睛，打大警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stray laser beam entering an eye, with a large warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 所以杂散激光射进眼里，最危险。

shots.section_title: 晶状体聚焦：进眼的光强许多倍
shots.scene: 视网膜上的伤点，旁边没有疼痛符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small burn on the retina with no pain symbol beside it, and a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 视网膜不觉得疼，伤了可能不知道。

shots.section_title: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
shots.scene: 光谱条从紫外到红外，分别指向眼睛不同部位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spectrum strip from ultraviolet to infrared, arrows pointing to different parts of an eye. No text.
shots.narration: 波长不同，伤眼的部位不同。
overlay: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同

shots.section_title: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
shots.scene: 短波紫外停在角膜，角膜发红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: short ultraviolet rays stopping at the cornea, which turns red and sore. No text.
shots.narration: 短波紫外，主要伤角膜。

shots.section_title: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
shots.scene: 长波紫外进到晶状体，晶状体变浑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: longer ultraviolet rays reaching the eye lens, which becomes cloudy. No text.
shots.narration: 长波紫外，主要伤晶状体。

shots.section_title: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
shots.scene: 可见光和近红外一直射到眼底，被聚焦
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: visible and near infrared rays passing all the way to the retina and being focused to a point. No text.
shots.narration: 可见光和近红外直达视网膜，最危险。

shots.section_title: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
shots.scene: 远红外激光停在眼睛表面，表面发热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a far infrared laser beam stopping at the surface of the eye, heat lines on the cornea. No text.
shots.narration: 远红外激光被角膜吸收，灼伤表面。

shots.section_title: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
shots.scene: 热伤、光化学伤、脉冲冲击三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a flame for heat, a molecule for light chemistry and a burst for a short pulse. No text.
shots.narration: 伤害有热伤、光化学伤和冲击伤。

shots.section_title: 波长不同，伤眼部位不同
shots.scene: 眼前部和眼底两处都打警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: both the front of the eye and the back of the eye marked with warning symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外伤前部，近红外伤眼底，都要防。

shots.section_title: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
shots.scene: 眼睛排第一，皮肤排第二
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a podium with an eye on the top step and a patch of skin on the second step. No text.
shots.narration: 激光伤害，皮肤排在眼睛之后。
overlay: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害

shots.section_title: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
shots.scene: 皮肤剖面：角质层、表皮、真皮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cross section of skin showing the outer layer, the epidermis and the dermis. No text.
shots.narration: 最外是角质层，下面是表皮和真皮。

shots.section_title: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
shots.scene: 黑色素颗粒挡住紫外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dark pigment grains in the epidermis catching ultraviolet rays and shielding the layer below. No text.
shots.narration: 黑色素吸收紫外，保护真皮。

shots.section_title: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
shots.scene: 可见光和近红外大多被皮肤反射，紫外被吸收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: visible and near infrared rays mostly bouncing off the skin while ultraviolet rays are absorbed. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外容易被吸收，最需提防。

shots.section_title: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
shots.scene: 强光束长时间照射，热量钻到深层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a strong beam shining for a long time, heat reaching deep into the skin layers. No text.
shots.narration: 光够强、照够久，任何波长都伤深层。

shots.section_title: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
shots.scene: 远红外激光在手背上烧出一个点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a far infrared laser beam burning a small spot on the back of a hand. No text.
shots.narration: 远红外激光，对皮肤热伤最明显。

shots.section_title: 皮肤的结构与激光伤害
shots.scene: 长期紫外照射，皮肤老化，打警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: skin that ages and wrinkles after years of ultraviolet exposure, with a warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 长期受紫外照，皮肤老化、易致癌。

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 光束在几个表面之间来回反射
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser beam bouncing between several surfaces on an optical table. No text.
shots.narration: 激光会在多个表面之间反射。

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 光束打到镜片、玻璃、金属面，反射进眼睛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam reflecting off a lens, a glass plate and a shiny metal surface into an eye. No text.
shots.narration: 镜面反射光，和原光束一样伤眼。

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 光亮的金属工件反射光照向手臂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shiny metal workpiece reflecting a beam onto a nearby forearm. No text.
shots.narration: 金属反光还能灼伤皮肤。

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 粗糙表面把光散向四面八方
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rough matte surface scattering a beam in all directions over a wide area. No text.
shots.narration: 漫反射散到很大范围，强激光也伤人。

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 小研开光前在纸上画出每一路反射光
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sketches every reflected beam path on a notepad before switching on the laser.
shots.narration: 开光前，用反射定律想好每一路光。

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 光束过了焦点，散开成锥形
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a focused beam passing its focal point and spreading out into a cone. No text.
shots.narration: 光束过了焦点，会发散成锥形。
overlay: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 离得越远，光斑越大越淡，远处人仍打警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the spot growing larger and fainter with distance, a person far away still marked with a warning. No text.
shots.narration: 越远越分散，远处照样能伤人。

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 光束一端到一条界线，界线内标危险
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam with a boundary line drawn across it, the zone inside the line shaded as dangerous. No text.
shots.narration: 危害距离内，直视光束都危险。

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 工件周围画出反射区，人站在区外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shaded reflection zone around a workpiece, people standing outside the zone. No text.
shots.narration: 工件周围是反射区，人要远离。

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 眼睛往出光口里看，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye peering into the beam exit nozzle of a laser head, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不要往出光口里看。

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 跑偏的光从机器门缝射出，眼睛贴缝看打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stray beam escaping through a gap in a machine door, an eye looking through the gap crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 跑偏的光会射出机外，别从缝隙看。

shots.section_title: 看不见的激光更危险
shots.scene: 看得见的红光和看不见的红外虚线光并排
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a visible red beam beside an invisible infrared beam drawn as a dotted line. No text.
shots.narration: 很多大功率激光是红外光，看不见。

shots.section_title: 看不见的激光更危险
shots.scene: 辉光很亮，但真正的激光束画成虚线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser tube with a bright glow, while the real output beam is shown only as a dotted line. No text.
shots.narration: 看见的辉光不是激光，激光看不见。

shots.section_title: 看不见的激光更危险
shots.scene: 【实拍】激光设备控制面板上的出光指示灯和功率表特写（不出光）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a laser control panel with an emission indicator lamp and a power meter.
shots.narration: 只能看仪表，判断有没有出光。

shots.section_title: 看不见的激光更危险
shots.scene: 眼睛来不及眨，光已经进去了
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an invisible beam reaching an eye before the eyelid can close. No text.
shots.narration: 看不见，就来不及眨眼躲开。

shots.section_title: 看不见的激光更危险
shots.scene: 揭开护罩，看不见的光射到纸箱上起火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a machine cover lifted, an invisible beam escaping and setting a cardboard box on fire. No text.
shots.narration: 开盖出光，射到哪里哪里起火。

shots.section_title: 看不见的激光更危险
shots.scene: 护罩只由老李按规程打开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a machine cover with a checklist in hand, others standing back.
shots.narration: 护罩只由懂行的维修人员打开。

shots.section_title: 看不见的激光更危险
shots.scene: 【实拍】试机时人员站在焊接围挡外，门口有激光警告标志（不出光）
shots.prompt_en: Two people stand outside a welding screen barrier beside a laser warning sign at the entrance.
shots.narration: 修好试机更小心，人在围挡外。

shots.section_title: 定位红光也不直视
shots.scene: 红色定位光点和不可见加工光同出一个头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one laser head giving a small red aiming dot and an invisible working beam drawn as a dotted line. No text.
shots.narration: 红光定位，看不见的红外光加工。

shots.section_title: 定位红光也不直视
shots.scene: 眼睛直视红色定位光，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye staring into the red aiming light, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 定位红光功率小，也不要直视。

shots.section_title: 定位红光也不直视
shots.scene: 只看工件表面的红点，加工光开关处于关闭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an operator looking at the red dot on the workpiece surface while the working beam switch is off. No text.
shots.narration: 对红点时，出光使能保持关闭。

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 阿杰捂眼，另一只手拍下急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers one eye and presses the emergency stop button with the other hand.
shots.narration: 疑似受照，立即停止出光。
overlay: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 离开工位，手揉眼打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stepping away from the workstation, a hand rubbing the eye crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 离开工位，不要揉眼睛。

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who picks up the phone at once.
shots.narration: 马上报告实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 医院眼科检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye doctor examining a patient's eye with a slit lamp in a clinic. No text.
shots.narration: 尽快去眼科，没疼也要查。

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 自己对着激光试视力，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person testing their own sight by looking at a laser beam, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别自己对着光试视力。

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 情况严重，手机拨号120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mobile phone dialling 120 for an ambulance. No text.
shots.narration: 情况紧急，拨打120。

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 皮肤烫伤在流动冷水下冲，火苗旁电话119
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burned hand under running cool water, and a phone dialling 119 beside a small flame. No text.
shots.narration: 烫伤先冷水冲，起火拨119。

shots.section_title: 眼睛疑似受照：停光、报告、就医
shots.scene: 报告学院和学校，记录经过，设备贴停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report form, a college building and a laser with a blank out of service tag. No text.
shots.narration: 逐级报告，查明原因再开机。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 眼球剖面，眼底聚焦亮点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway eye with a bright focused point on the retina. No text.
shots.narration: 晶状体聚光，近红外和可见光伤眼底。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 镜面反射、漫反射、看不见的光三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a mirror reflection, a scattering surface and a dotted invisible beam. No text.
shots.narration: 反射光、看不见的光一样危险。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 停光、报告、就医三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an emergency stop button, a person reporting and an eye clinic. No text.
shots.narration: 疑似受照：停光、报告、就医。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣戴上一副激光防护眼镜，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot puts on a pair of laser safety goggles and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光防护眼镜。
